Second, starting tomorrow, I shall fast each morning and dangle a flatbread a foot before my brows. Inhaling deeply and contracting my belly, I'll nibble slowly. Though akin to a donkey sniffing grass, three months of this shall carve eight abs!

Third, the secret to long legs lies in the shin, not the thigh! My custom "Kunlun Slave Elevator Shoes" feature triple-layered tanned ox tendons in the soles. With robes widened by three inches, none shall notice.

Fourth, sinewy strength lies in refinement, not bulk—70% vigor, 30% grace. This is the bone of a man, the bane of women. How can burly brutes compare to my sleek, heroic physique?

Fifth, the incense recipe: three Sichuan peppercorns, five mint leaves, and fresh green walnut husks, steeped in Wine for three nights. Burn this after bathing to banish sweat stench. With such fragrant allure, how could Xiaoyan resist?

Where no spark is struck, affection ignites on its own.

Unlike reckless brutes who obsess over brute muscle, I cultivate elegance. Xiaoyan's heart shall belong to Hu!
